unproven.reason: No connected boards: DMA/USART/SPI/I2C waveforms, electrical effects, IRQ WCET, cache interactions and HIL fault timing are not executed.
Finite duplex TX/RX independence and continuous RX rotate/drain are covered separately; every simultaneous TX cancellation/RX wrap ordering is not exhaustive.
GPIO/EXTI/PWM/watchdog/Flash/CAN/USB/Ethernet own distinct maintained suites; this finite request/block catalogue does not claim their complete lifecycle coverage.
Byte/event IRQ receive and base UART tests exist; not every byte-ring profile and secondary-controller cancellation history is represented here.

Strict mode/resource conflict and authored-limit tests execute through existing configure suite; this Google catalogue does not infer Python case execution from source names or expand reviewed Board routes.
Selected bounded register fault windows and Native histories are examples, not proof against every timing, ABA bank wrap or concurrent unsupported caller.
Only ordinary reviewed TEST/TEST_F bodies are indexed; parameterized/typed/death-only aggregate properties need explicit review rather than automatic name inference.
